body: The configuration needs to be created as described in https://angular.io/guide/testing#configuration

Thanks for your reply. I just wanted to point out that after you have removed automatic generation of karma.conf.js in ng15, you will need to update you docs. I know how to generate a karma.conf.js - but others maybe do not. After all I thought the goal was to make it easier to ng newbees

@arambazamba, we did update the documentation, but I looks like we missed some places. That said, this is an open source project and this is an excellent issue for first time contributes. Feel free to open a PR to improve the documentation. Thank you before hand.

*testing-code-coverage.md* now displays an informational alert summarizing the update and provides a link to *aio/content/guide/testing.md#configuration* for more detailed instructions to manually setup `karma.conf.js`.
